safeguards.name: actual hidden-scorer hash binding
safeguards.rationale: The preregistration and analyzer bind native_cleanup_effect_runner_v1.py because V3 delegates its private scoring primitives to that implementation.

safeguards.name: canonical-owner identity contract
safeguards.rationale: Hidden tests assert that cross-module consumers and integration adapters reference the actual policy symbols before monkeypatching them.

safeguards.name: append-only raw shape and score-time artifact binding
safeguards.rationale: The analyzer rejects unplanned task directories, task-level files, unexpected condition artifacts, and any post-score change to the candidate diff or pre-score inputs.

safeguards.name: strict sequential condition collection
safeguards.rationale: The runner refuses to prepare a later condition until each predecessor has been scored and stores predecessor score hashes in the subsequent condition credential.

safeguards.name: independent adversarial review
safeguards.rationale: A separate reviewer independently ran each former bypass and confirmed that current V3 rejects it.

design_boundary.rationale: The materializer owns fixture semantics, the runner owns sequencing and scoring-time commitments, preregistration owns frozen inputs, and the analyzer owns eligibility.

dependency_audit.rationale: No dependency or lockfile changed; the protocol uses the standard library and existing native Codex facilities.

extension_decision.rationale: V3 is an internal versioned evaluation protocol, not a new public extension interface.

data_ownership.rationale: Public task trees, private hidden/reference trees, candidate workspaces, raw artifacts, frozen snapshots, and evidence outputs have distinct owners and lifecycles.

error_model.rationale: Hash drift, missing or extra artifacts, failed checks, retry attempts, and sequence violations are explicit ineligible outcomes rather than retryable successes.

contract_evolution.rationale: V3 uses fresh identifiers and a new envelope while preserving V1/V2 invalidations as immutable historical audit records.

operational_budget.rationale: The preregistration fixes a 300-second agent limit, 20-second test limit, one block per task, and no early-stop or selective-retry rule.

threat_boundary.rationale: Hidden/reference paths and condition outcomes are outside declared agent input, while the shared-filesystem limitation is explicitly recorded as protocol rather than OS isolation.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: V3 scripts, tests, manifest, preregistration, README, evidence, and review form one atomic pre-collection scope that is frozen before any trial starts.

release_recovery.rationale: This offline experiment has no production release, feature flag, or user rollout.

data_migration.rationale: No production persistence, schema, or backfill is changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: The native protocol stores no API key, credential, or runtime secret.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package manifest, lockfile, or third-party component is added or updated.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The README, preregistration, invalidation records, review report, and this ledger state collection operation and claim limits.

reproducibility.rationale: Deterministic materialization plus hash-bound manifest, preregistration, score-time artifacts, and committed command output expose source or collection drift.

rollback_or_compatibility: Before the first V3 trial, revert the V3 scripts, tests, manifest, preregistration, frozen snapshots, README, evidence outputs, and this ledger together if a protocol defect is found. After a V3 trial begins, preserve the frozen envelope and raw artifacts; invalidate rather than amend, retry, or selectively exclude collection data.

independent_review.notes: The reviewer independently reproduced all four former bypasses and verified current rejection. Approval is limited to V3 protocol preparation and explicitly excludes a Skill-effect or model-wide capability claim.

remaining_risks: No V3 trial has run, so no improvement in cleanup, repair success, causal analysis, or model capability has been demonstrated.
Native subagents share a filesystem; declared workspace limits are protocol isolation, not an OS or container security boundary.
The ten-task synthetic corpus is targeted and small; even a completed positive result would be limited to the frozen model, Harness, Skill snapshots, corpus, and scorer.
Collection must use a frozen commit and strict sequential execution; any interruption, retry, extra artifact, or frozen-input drift makes the collection ineligible.
